about.title: About me
about.heading: Hi there! I'm Abel
about.intro: I'm Abel (Truong Hung An) - a Shopify Developer with 4+ years of experience working on projects for clients in the US, Australia, and Canada at international agencies.
about.paragraph1: Currently, I'm a Shopify Developer at Teifi Digital, where I work with international clients such as Glass Warehouse USA, Valhalla Pure Outfitters (Canada), PLI Card Marketing Solutions,.... Previously, I worked at Beginning Boutique (Australia's leading fashion brand) and ArenaCommerce. Throughout this journey, I've accumulated extensive experience in Shopify theme customization, checkout extensions, app development, and performance optimization.
about.paragraph2: ABTECH (ABEL TECHNOLOGY HOUSEHOLD BUSINESS) was born from my desire to use this international expertise to directly serve merchants in Vietnam and Southeast Asia - those who find it difficult to access large agencies due to budget constraints or smaller project scopes.
about.paragraph3: I work directly 1-on-1 with founders/shop owners, account managers, and charge per project package rather than hourly. Using AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT-CodeX, GitHub Copilot) helps speed up delivery without ever compromising code quality.

items.question: Are you working full-time? What's the response time?
items.answer: I'm currently working full-time at Teifi Digital, ABTECH is a part-time activity (evenings and weekends). I respond to messages within 24-48h (business days). Due to part-time nature, I only take 2-3 projects per month to ensure the best quality for each client.

items.question: Do you accept international payments?
items.answer: Yes, I accept payment via Agribank bank transfer (domestic) or international wire transfer. Can be split into 2 installments: 50% to start, 50% upon completion and delivery.

items.question: Do you provide post-delivery support?
items.answer: Yes, I provide post-delivery support for the agreed period (usually 1-2 weeks) to ensure everything runs smoothly. If bugs arise from my code, I'll fix them for free. After the support period, we can arrange a separate maintenance package if needed.

items.question: Do you take urgent fixes?
items.answer: Depends on my current workload. If it's a critical bug affecting business operations, I'll prioritize and arrange accordingly. Best to contact in advance to discuss specific timelines.

items.question: Why choose ABTECH over a large agency?
items.answer: Large agencies typically charge $25-49/hour, work through account managers, and bill by the hour. With ABTECH, you communicate directly 1-on-1 with me (the actual developer), get clear fixed-price quotes, and benefit from international experience at more reasonable costs. Perfect for small to medium projects that need dedicated attention.
